title: Geological studies of the Charleston, South Carolina, area--elevation contours on the top of the Cooper Formation
citation: Force, L.M., 1978, Geological studies of the Charleston, South Carolina, area--elevation contours on the top of the Cooper Formation: U.S. Geological Survey Miscellaneous Field Studies Map MF-1021-A, map scale 1:250,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; the map face is garbled. The text cites 'Rankin, 1978' while the reference list gives 1977. The map was compiled from more than 500 drill logs (USGS, SC Geological Survey and others); none are listed. Legend-only items (the -5 example contour label, depression and scarp symbols on the index map) not recorded.
SUBSURFACE: structure-contour map of the top of the Cooper Formation (stored under contours): no contour labels are legible in the text layer and the contour interval is not printed in the text; the explanation shades areas where the top is more than 25 m below mean sea level (legend only, no locations). Surface dips seaward at less than 1 m/km. Datum: mean sea level. No cross section. Base maps 1:250,000 (James Island, Savannah, Georgetown, Augusta), UTM projection.
